description: This file defines functions and types for formatting and generating message envelopes in an auto-reply system, including timestamp handling, header sanitization, and message formatting for inbound and outbound messages.

methods.name: sanitizeEnvelopeHeaderPart
methods.description: Sanitizes header parts by collapsing whitespace, neutralizing brackets, and keeping ASCII characters.

methods.name: resolveEnvelopeFormatOptions
methods.description: Resolves envelope format options from configuration, providing default settings.

methods.name: normalizeEnvelopeOptions
methods.description: Normalizes envelope options, setting default values for includeTimestamp and includeElapsed.

methods.name: resolveEnvelopeTimezone
methods.description: Determines the timezone mode for envelope timestamps based on options.

methods.name: formatEnvelopeTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a string according to envelope options and timezone.

methods.name: formatAgentEnvelope
methods.description: Creates a formatted envelope string with header and body, including timestamp and metadata.

methods.name: formatInboundEnvelope
methods.description: Formats an inbound message envelope, including sender label and message body.

methods.name: formatInboundFromLabel
methods.description: Generates a label for a message sender, handling group and direct message labels.

methods.name: formatThreadStarterEnvelope
methods.description: Formats a message envelope for thread starter messages.
